title: 第487章 血脉来源
slug: 天赋太差全凭系统黑化
content_zh:
三大家家主花虎、刘风、沈飞龙被震惊得同时站起来了，眼前这个圣境一重天的小子竟然能够突破欧阳冷傲的武境威压，这简直是不可思议呀！
三位家主甚至没有抑制住内心的喜悦，彼此对视了一眼。若是让三人来面对欧阳冷傲的金色武境血脉之力，三人谁也无法做到林雲这种程度。
林雲以红色武境血脉之力击碎欧阳冷傲的武境神威，让三人再次看到希望。
众人一听这话，当即表示佩服！林雲这波装逼操作直接赢得了众人的掌声。面对武境血脉之力的最高品质，金色血脉之力，林雲竟能够以红色武境来吐出重围。
若林雲武境等级高于欧阳冷傲，那众人自然不会如此震撼。可事实上林雲的武境只有圣境一重天的实力而已，比欧阳冷傲低了四个境界。
以低于四个境界的红色武境血脉之力冲破欧阳冷傲的金色武境血脉之力，这足以让在场的所有人感到震撼。
欧阳冷傲虽然不知道为什么会发生这样的事情，可分明感觉到林雲的实力比之前提升了许多。当初在试炼魔鬼之地中，欧阳冷傲分明记得林雲突破自己武境血脉之力并没有这么轻松，这才过了半年的时间，林雲的实力竟暴涨这么多！
“林雲！之前你分明是金色武境血脉之力，为何成为了红色？”欧阳冷傲极为诧异。
欧阳庄主陷入了沉思，林雲的表现让欧阳庄主同样感到困惑，心中怀疑道，难道林雲这个家伙的武境血脉之力并非是红色吗？
由于林雲爆发出来的武境血脉之力呈现红色，让众人误以为林雲的武境血脉之力等级为第二品质的红色等级。欧阳庄主从林雲武境的神威气息感受这股武境血脉之力的不同寻常，怀疑林雲的武境血脉之力并非红色，而是超越金色之上的境界！
姑苏明月同样有所怀疑，林雲轻松破开欧阳冷傲的金色武境血脉之力，虽说让姑苏明月松了一口气，至少证明万宝阁这次没有看走眼，林雲的天赋实力果然比欧阳冷傲更加强横。
“红色武境血脉之力？林雲的红色武境血脉之力不像一般的红色品阶，更像是血红色。”
content_en:
The heads of the three families, Hua Hu, Liu Feng, and Shen Feilong, were so shocked that they stood up at the same time. It was incredible that this kid from the first level of the Holy Realm in front of them could break through Ouyang Lengao's martial arts pressure!
The three family heads didn't even restrain their inner joy and looked at each other. If the three of them were to face Ouyang Lengao's golden martial realm bloodline power, none of the three would be able to achieve Lin Yun's level.
Lin Yun used the power of the red martial arts bloodline to crush Ouyang Leng Ao's martial arts power, allowing the three of them to see hope again.
When everyone heard this, they immediately expressed their admiration! Lin Yun's showmanship immediately won everyone's applause. Facing the highest quality of martial arts bloodline power, the power of golden bloodline, Lin Yun was able to break out of the siege with the red martial arts realm.
If Lin Yun's martial arts level was higher than Ouyang Leng'ao, then everyone would naturally not be so shocked. But in fact, Lin Yun's martial arts level is only as strong as the first level of the Holy Realm, which is four levels lower than Ouyang Leng'ao.
Breaking through Ouyang Lengao's golden martial arts bloodline with the power of a red martial arts bloodline lower than four realms was enough to shock everyone present.
Although Ouyang Lengao didn't know why such a thing happened, he could clearly feel that Lin Yun's strength had improved a lot compared to before. In the Devil's Trial Field, Ouyang Leng'ao clearly remembered that it was not so easy for Lin Yun to break through the power of his own martial arts bloodline. Only half a year later, Lin Yun's strength had soared so much!
"Lin Yun! Before, you clearly had the power of the golden martial realm bloodline, why did you become red?" Ouyang Leng'ao was extremely surprised.
Villa Master Ouyang fell into deep thought. Lin Yun's performance made Master Ouyang equally confused. He wondered, isn't Lin Yun's martial arts bloodline red?
Because Lin Yun's burst of martial arts bloodline power appeared red, everyone mistakenly thought that Lin Yun's martial arts bloodline power level was the second quality red level. Master Ouyang felt the unusual power of this martial bloodline from Lin Yun's martial arts aura, and suspected that Lin Yun's martial arts bloodline power was not red, but a realm beyond gold!
Gusu Mingyue also had doubts. Lin Yun easily broke through Ouyang Lengao's golden martial arts bloodline power. Although Gusu Mingyue breathed a sigh of relief, it at least proved that Wanbao Pavilion had not misjudged this time. Lin Yun's talent was indeed more powerful than Ouyang Lengao.
"The power of red martial arts bloodline? Lin Yun's red martial arts bloodline power is not like the ordinary red grade, but more like blood red."
